title: Prove usage import through the typed importer instead of its command

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The maintained no-activity Refresh case detected a stale persisted check time after a successful typed Refresh.

The check covered `SEED-413#prove-usage-import-through-typed-importer`, revision `a542045b824e24e73490f7ecc3e733852b879f16`, Slice 6. In an isolated detached scratch checkout, the three-task fixture imported private Codex rollouts and then performed a Refresh without changing them. The focused command was `env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR npm run test:dashboard:backend -- usage-history/repeated-checks.spec.ts --grep 'a Refresh with no rollout activity' --workers=2`. Each run selected one case.

The only fault changed `dashboard/server/usageRefresh.ts:234` to record a timestamp 1 ms earlier while returning the current check time. The baseline passed. With the fault in place, the exact JSON check-record assertion for the second Refresh failed at `dashboard/backend-tests/usage-history/repeated-checks.spec.ts:124`. It expected `2026-11-24T14:43:20.654Z` and read `2026-11-24T14:43:20.653Z`. The store snapshot assertion directly preceding it passed. An independent no-activity Refresh witness in a separate private home confirmed a 1 ms mismatch between the returned time and the persisted and chart-input time, with unchanged store bytes, inode and modification time. Restoration matched the original file bytes and clean worktree state. The focused case passed again, and the scratch checkout was removed. [Fault diff](/private/tmp/intent-coverage-seed-413.Gm77wJ/fault.diff) · [Failing run](/private/tmp/intent-coverage-seed-413.Gm77wJ/fault.log) · [Independent witness](/private/tmp/intent-coverage-seed-413.Gm77wJ/witness.log) · [Restored proof](/private/tmp/intent-coverage-seed-413.Gm77wJ/restored.json)

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing check-record assertion for this path. The result supports the current plan's completed Refresh coverage.

- **Test runtime.** 3,870 ms measured from the maintained runner's terminal proof records across the three focused runs. Baseline 2,267 ms, fault 623 ms, restored 980 ms.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable because human time was uninstrumented.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable because the delegated run exposed no independent agent-effort measure.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 107771 ms (measured), from 1795531326734 to 1795531434505 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition for a542045b824e24e73490f7ecc3e733852b879f16. Caught, with no follow-up required.
